name: coordinator
description: Owns Khaled's calendar. Reads time requests from the Supabase ledger, proposes slots against his rules and three calendars, sends a short numbered digest, and books only what he approves on the Coordinator calendar. Khaled can add, edit, repeat (every N weeks), list and withdraw requests, and set Todoist reminders, from chat (intake). Needs the Google Calendar, Supabase and Todoist connectors.
